page_note: Classic two-half editorial structure. First half (segs 0-20) preserves substrate teaching about TWO cosmic letters: the Calling sent forth from the Living Spirit to the molding of man, and the Answer sent back from First Man up to the Living Spirit. Both sides of these mappings stay within the cosmic system (Living Spirit, First Man, molding of man, archons, wars/contests). Second half (segs 21-36) extends the letter-pattern to a THIRD letter — the Mind of Light from Christ the Beloved sent to 'the holy Church' — which is the editorial seam: the cosmic letter-structure is now applied to the contemporary Manichaean ecclesial community. Editorial fatigue score (ecclesial 0.0→14.5) confirms this seam exactly. Heavy manuscript damage (78.4%) makes some boundaries provisional. Seg 0 is dialogue frame opener.
